mainEntity.name: Do I need to download anything?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Arcanetable runs entirely in your browser. No download, no install, no account.

mainEntity.name: How do I play with a friend?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copy the invite link from the deck picker and send it to your friend. They click it and are instantly at the same table — no account needed on either end.

Arcanetable supports Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon TCG, and Yu-Gi-Oh out of the box. It also supports custom card systems, so you can play any homebrew or indie TCG by pointing Arcanetable at your own card server.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Arcanetable for proxy testing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Arcanetable is great for testing proxy decks, cubes, and brews before you sleeve up the real thing.

mainEntity.name: Is Arcanetable an alternative to untap.in or Cockatrice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Like untap.in and Cockatrice, Arcanetable is a free TCG playtesting sandbox. Unlike them, Arcanetable runs entirely in the browser with no download or account required, and renders cards on a 3D table.
